claim: Physcomitrella patens has three Aux/IAA genes: IAA1A, IAA1B, and IAA2.

claim: A triple mutant lacking all three Aux/IAA genes (aux/iaaΔ) was generated in Physcomitrella patens.
source: To study the role of these genes in auxin response and plant development, and to simplify the study of auxin response mechanisms, we generated a mutant lacking all three genes.
evidence: The text explicitly states that the authors generated a mutant lacking all three Aux/IAA genes.

claim: The aux/iaaΔ mutant displays a constitutive auxin response phenotype.

evidence: The text describes GUS staining results and refers to Figure 1B showing constitutive auxin response.

claim: The aux/iaaΔ mutant is completely insensitive to auxin.
source: The aux/iaaΔ mutant produced gametophores with ectopic rhizoids and was completely insensitive to auxin (Figure 1C).
evidence: The text explicitly states the mutant is completely insensitive to auxin, with reference to Figure 1C.

claim: The aux/iaaΔ mutant shows no changes in gene expression upon auxin treatment.
